name: Nissan Skyline GT-R (R32, 1989)
chassisNote: Same coupe archetype as the R34 already in the game; ATTESA E-TS AWD via fit.drive awd.

gearset.src: FS5R30A factory ratios and 4.111 final (R32/R33 GT-R); commonly tabulated from Nissan service data / GTRUSA gear-ratio sheets.

enginePreset.name: Nissan RB26DETT (Skyline GT-R R32)
enginePreset.note: Nissan Heritage quotes 280 PS (206 kW) / 353 Nm. hp field is 276 (280 PS as SAE hp), same convention as the R34 RB26 preset. Torque is the R32 sheet's 353 Nm. Gentlemen's agreement; real cars made more — do not raise the rating to fit tests.

note: Curb 1430 kg and 280 PS / 353 Nm from Nissan Heritage Collection (BNR32). Cd 0.40 from secondary GT-R chassis tables (listed unsure). Frontal area = 1.755 × 1.340 × 0.81 ≈ 1.91 m² (estimate). fWt 0.55 layout estimate for AWD coupe. Top speed often quoted ~250 km/h limited; 0–100 ~5.0–5.3 s from period tests (5.2 stored, unsure). Boost 0.78 bar (~0.78 kg/cm²) typical for stock ceramic twins (unsure). Front rotor ~296 mm common figure for early R32 (unsure). Separate engine preset from the R34 RB26 entry so the R32's 353 Nm sheet is not overwritten.
